accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research. Brittle or damaged items are available at the discretion of RAC.

bioghist.head: Biographical / Historical
bioghist.p: Cleon Swayzee worked for over ten years at the Ford Foundation. In 1952, he was appointed Director of Research for the Board on Overseas Training and Research. He continued with that program when its name changed to the International Training and Research Program in 1955. He was later promoted from Program Associate to Associate Director and stayed with the program up until the point where it merged into the International Division following a change in the Foundation's programming in 1966.
